title: Parkingeye Ltd v Velindre University NHS Trust & Cardiff and Vale University Health Board
description: The contracting authorities awarded a £10-20 million car park management services contract to National Parking Control Group (NPCG) over incumbent provider Parkingeye Ltd, which challenged the award citing transparency breaches, evaluation methodology issues, and inconsistent treatment of bidders. The court refused to lift the automatic suspension on contract signature pending a full trial of Parkingeye's claims.
contracting_authority_name: Velindre University NHS Trust / Cardiff and Vale University Health Board
